name: The Ritz-Carlton, Almaty
positioning: High-rise Ritz-Carlton in Almaty's Esentai Tower, with mountain and city views, next to Esentai Mall
best_for: Travelers who want mountain and city views from a high-rise base
Guests who like shopping and dining in the same complex

facts.text: Esentai Mall is in the same complex as the hotel.
All accommodations offer panoramic city and mountain views.
Bathrooms in the rooms have underfloor heating.
Check-in takes place in a lounge area on the 30th floor, where guests are offered apple tea.
Vista, on the 30th floor, is an all-day restaurant focused on Mediterranean cuisine with Kazakh influence.
Seven Bar and Restaurant, on the 28th floor, combines European fine-dining cuisine, fresh sushi and mixology.
Sky Bar and Lounge, on the 30th floor, has a panoramic view of the city.
The hotel has a fitness center with a swimming pool and sauna.
The hotel runs the Ritz Kids program for young guests.
Shymbulak Mountain Resort is 30 minutes from the hotel.

highlights.text: The hotel is located within Central Asia's tallest building.
The hotel serves a ceremonial offering of Kazakh national sweets and tea in the 30th-floor lobby.
The Ritz-Carlton Club is on the 26th floor.
The Ritz-Carlton Suite has a private library and a gourmet kitchenette.

considerations.text: Almaty International Airport is approximately 25 km from the hotel.
Entering the Club Lounge requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not give free access.
WhataHotel notes limited dining options compared to major metropolitan hotels.
